clips.zh: 他一直很努力，所以成绩提高得很快。
clips.en: He has always worked hard, so his grades improve very quickly.
notes: 一直 yìzhí: 一 is said yì (falling) before the rising 直.
提高 tígāo: a rise, then a high flat tone.

clips.zh: 我对这个城市的交通不太满意。
clips.en: I am not very satisfied with the traffic in this city.
notes: 交通 jiāotōng: both syllables are high and flat.
不太 bú tài: 不 is said bú (rising) before a falling tone.

clips.zh: 老师批评了他，但是也表扬了他的努力。
clips.en: The teacher criticised him, but also praised his effort.
notes: 批评 pīpíng: a high tone, then a rise.
表扬 biǎoyáng: 表 only dips before the rising 扬.

clips.zh: 这家餐厅的菜味道很特别，价格也不高。
clips.en: The flavour at this restaurant is special, and the prices are not high either.
notes: 味道 wèidào: both syllables fall.
特别 tèbié: a fall, then a rise.

clips.zh: 如果你有困难，可以给我打电话。
clips.en: If you have any difficulty, you can call me.
notes: 困难 kùnnan: the second syllable is light and short.
打电话 dǎ diànhuà: a dip, then fall, fall.

clips.zh: 他的汉语说得越来越流利了。
clips.en: His Chinese is getting more and more fluent.
notes: 越来越 yuè lái yuè: fall, rise, fall.
流利 liúlì: a rise, then a fall.

clips.zh: 为了保护环境，我们应该少用塑料。
clips.en: To protect the environment, we should use less plastic.
notes: 保护 bǎohù: 保 only dips before the falling 护.
塑料 sùliào: both syllables fall.

clips.zh: 经理让大家下午三点准时开会。
clips.en: The manager asked everyone to have the meeting at three o'clock sharp this afternoon.
notes: 准时 zhǔnshí: 准 only dips before the rising 时.
开会 kāihuì: a high tone, then a fall.

clips.zh: 昨天的演出非常精彩，观众们都笑了。
clips.en: Yesterday's performance was wonderful, and the audience all laughed.
notes: 精彩 jīngcǎi: a high tone, then a dip.
演出 yǎnchū: 演 only dips before the high 出.

clips.zh: 我的手机突然没电了，所以无法联系你。
clips.en: My phone suddenly ran out of battery, so I could not contact you.
notes: 突然 tūrán: a high tone, then a rise.
无法 wúfǎ: a rise, then a dip.

clips.zh: 这个城市的交通比以前方便多了。
clips.en: The traffic in this city is much more convenient than before.
notes: 方便 fāngbiàn: a high tone, then a fall.
以前 yǐqián: 以 only dips before the rising 前.

clips.zh: 他故意不说话，让大家有点担心。
clips.en: He deliberately does not speak, which makes everyone a bit worried.
notes: 故意 gùyì: both syllables fall.
担心 dānxīn: both syllables are high and flat.

clips.zh: 请把这些材料整理好，下午交给我。
clips.en: Please sort these materials out and hand them to me this afternoon.
notes: 整理 zhěnglǐ: two third tones in a row, so 整 rises (say zhénglǐ).
材料 cáiliào: a rise, then a fall.

clips.zh: 虽然他很累，但是仍然坚持工作。
clips.en: Although he is tired, he still keeps on working.
notes: 仍然 réngrán: both syllables rise.
坚持 jiānchí: a high tone, then a rise.

clips.zh: 我们要互相帮助，共同完成这个任务。
clips.en: We must help each other and complete this task together.
notes: 互相 hùxiāng: a fall, then a high tone.
共同 gòngtóng: a fall, then a rise.

clips.zh: 无论天气怎么样，我都要去跑步。
clips.en: No matter what the weather is like, I will go running.
notes: 无论 wúlùn: a rise, then a fall.
怎么样 zěnmeyàng: 么 is light and short.

clips.zh: 他不但会说汉语，而且会写汉字。
clips.en: He can not only speak Chinese but also write characters.
notes: 不但 búdàn: 不 is said bú before the falling 但.
而且 érqiě: a rise, then a dip.

clips.zh: 请问，附近有银行或者超市吗？
clips.en: Excuse me, is there a bank or a supermarket nearby?
notes: 附近 fùjìn: both syllables fall.
或者 huòzhě: a fall, then a dip.

clips.zh: 听说这部电影非常有名，我想去看看。
clips.en: I hear this film is very famous, and I want to go and see it.
notes: 听说 tīngshuō: both syllables are high and flat.
有名 yǒumíng: 有 only dips before the rising 名.

clips.zh: 周末我们打算去参观一家工厂。
clips.en: This weekend we plan to visit a factory.
notes: 参观 cānguān: both syllables are high and flat.
打算 dǎsuàn: a dip, then a fall.

clips.zh: 他被老师表扬了，心里特别高兴。
clips.en: He was praised by the teacher and is especially happy.
notes: 被 bèi: a short fall that marks who does the action.
心里 xīnlǐ: a high tone, then a dip.

clips.zh: 我从来没有见过这么大的雪。
clips.en: I have never seen such heavy snow.
notes: 从来 cónglái: both syllables rise.
见过 jiàn guo: after a verb, 过 is light (guo).

clips.zh: 这件事很重要，也很复杂。
clips.en: This matter is very important and also very complicated.
notes: 重要 zhòngyào: both syllables fall.
复杂 fùzá: a fall, then a rise.

clips.zh: 请把声音关小一点，大家都在休息。
clips.en: Please turn the sound down a little; everyone is resting.
notes: 声音 shēngyīn: both syllables are high and flat.
休息 xiūxi: 息 is light and short.

clips.zh: 他在银行工作，每天都很忙。
clips.en: He works in a bank and is very busy every day.
notes: 银行 yínháng: both syllables rise; 行 is said háng here (a bank), not xíng.
工作 gōngzuò: a high tone, then a fall.

clips.zh: 我明天要把这本书还给他。
clips.en: Tomorrow I will return this book to him.
notes: 还 huán: said huán here (give back), a rise, not hái.
明天 míngtiān: a rise, then a high tone.

clips.zh: 我们要重新开始，这次一定能成功。
clips.en: We must start again, and this time we will surely succeed.
notes: 重新 chóngxīn: 重 is said chóng (again), a rise; then a high tone.
成功 chénggōng: a rise, then a high tone.

clips.zh: 她从小就爱好音乐，现在是一名老师。
clips.en: She has loved music since she was little, and now she is a teacher.
notes: 爱好 àihào: 好 is said hào here (to like), so both syllables fall.
一名 yì míng: 一 is said yì (falling) before the rising 名.

clips.zh: 我想了解一下这个城市的历史。
clips.en: I want to learn a bit about the history of this city.
notes: 了解 liǎojiě: two third tones in a row, so 了 rises (say liáojiě).
历史 lìshǐ: a fall, then a dip.

clips.zh: 这件衣服太长了，我想换一件。
clips.en: This piece of clothing is too long; I want to change it for another.
notes: 长 cháng: said cháng (long), a rise.
换一件 huàn yí jiàn: 一 is said yí (rising) before the falling 件.

clips.zh: 小狗长得很快，现在已经很重了。
clips.en: The puppy grows very fast and is already very heavy now.
notes: 长 zhǎng: said zhǎng (to grow), a dip.
重 zhòng: said zhòng (heavy), a fall.

clips.zh: 请问，我怎么去火车站？
clips.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
notes: 请问 qǐngwèn: 请 only dips before the falling 问.
怎么 zěnme: 么 is light and short.

clips.zh: 今天的作业太多了，我要做到很晚。
clips.en: There is too much homework today; I have to work until very late.
notes: 作业 zuòyè: both syllables fall.
很晚 hěn wǎn: two third tones in a row, so 很 rises (say hén wǎn).

clips.zh: 我一般七点起床，八点出门。
clips.en: I usually get up at 7 and go out at 8.
notes: 一般 yìbān: 一 is said yì (falling) before the high 般.
起床 qǐchuáng: 起 only dips before the rising 床.

clips.zh: 这个办法不错，我们可以试一试。
clips.en: This way is not bad; we can try it.
notes: 不错 búcuò: 不 is said bú before the falling 错.
试一试 shì yi shì: 一 is light and short between the two verbs.

clips.zh: 请大家安静，现在开始考试。
clips.en: Everyone, please be quiet; the exam starts now.
notes: 安静 ānjìng: a high tone, then a fall.
考试 kǎoshì: 考 only dips before the falling 试.

clips.zh: 他的声音很小，我听不清楚。
clips.en: His voice is very quiet, and I do not hear it clearly.
notes: 声音 shēngyīn: both syllables are high and flat.
清楚 qīngchu: the second syllable is light and short.

clips.zh: 我打算先去超市，然后回家做饭。
clips.en: I plan to go to the supermarket first, and then go home to cook.
notes: 打算 dǎsuàn: 打 only dips before the falling 算.
超市 chāoshì: a high tone, then a fall.

clips.zh: 你的建议很有用，谢谢你。
clips.en: Your suggestion is very useful; thank you.
notes: 建议 jiànyì: both syllables fall.
谢谢 xièxie: the second syllable is light and short.

clips.zh: 这里的空气比以前好多了。
clips.en: The air here is much better than before.
notes: 空气 kōngqì: a high tone, then a fall.
比以前 bǐ yǐqián: two third tones in a row, so 比 rises (say bí yǐqián).

clips.zh: 医生说我应该多休息，少喝咖啡。
clips.en: The doctor says I should rest more and drink less coffee.
notes: 应该 yīnggāi: both syllables are high and flat.
休息 xiūxi: the second syllable is light and short.

clips.zh: 上个星期的旅行，我们玩得非常开心。
clips.en: On last week's trip, we had a great time.
notes: 旅行 lǚxíng: 旅 only dips before the rising 行 (said xíng, not háng).
开心 kāixīn: both syllables are high and flat.

clips.zh: 他的房间很干净，东西也放得很好。
clips.en: His room is very clean, and things are put away well too.
notes: 干净 gānjìng: a high tone, then a fall.
东西 dōngxi: the second syllable is light and short.

clips.zh: 先生，请问您要点什么？
clips.en: Sir, what would you like to order?
notes: 先生 xiānsheng: the second syllable is light and short.
您要 nín yào: a rise, then a fall.

clips.zh: 我觉得这个电影很无聊，你觉得呢？
clips.en: I think this film is boring; what do you think?
notes: 觉得 juéde: 觉 is said jué here (to feel), a rise, and 得 is light.
无聊 wúliáo: both syllables rise.

clips.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人拿不动。
clips.en: This box is too heavy; I do not manage to carry it alone.
notes: 重 zhòng: said zhòng (heavy), a fall.
一个 yí ge: 一 is said yí (rising) before 个.

clips.zh: 我们先坐火车，再换汽车。
clips.en: We first take the train, and then change to a car.
notes: 火车 huǒchē: 火 only dips before the high 车.
汽车 qìchē: a fall, then a high tone.

clips.zh: 她的声音很好听，唱歌也很好。
clips.en: Her voice is very nice to listen to, and she sings well too.
notes: 好听 hǎotīng: 好 only dips before the high 听.
唱歌 chàng gē: a fall, then a high tone.
